raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Jimmy just played a Monopoly on Wood (עץ). He took 5 units total. Since I had 2 Wood, he likely got the other 3 from Claude. parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy just played a Monopoly on Wood (עץ). He took 5 units total. Since I had 2 Wood, he likely got the other 3 from Claude. This is a huge setback for me as I needed that wood for my road to the port, but it also severely hurts Claude. Jimmy is now very strong with 5 Wood and 2 Wheat. I need to acknowledge the sting but keep the alliance with Jimmy somewhat intact since Claude is the bigger threat.
parsed.note_to_self: Jimmy played Monopoly on Wood, taking my 2 Wood. Jimmy now has 5 Wood and 2 Wheat. Claude was also hit hard. I am left with only 1 Sheep.
parsed.say_outloud: וואו ג'ימי, זה כאב. לא ציפיתי לזה ממך אחרי כל העזרה הדדית. לפחות לקחת לקלוד יותר ממה שלקחת לי.
